name: eventium
description: Plugin-based event monitoring and notification dashboard platform
author: Relteco

scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @eventium/backend exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @eventium/backend exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:push: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @eventium/backend exec prisma db push
scripts.//prepare: husky is a local dev convenience: resolved from devDependencies (not fetched by npx, which breaks offline installs) and tolerated when absent, e.g. inside a Docker build where there is no .git
